sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
- Renew and improve the lower Dead Horse Gap Walking Track to provide a durable, high-quality walking experience.
- Reduce erosion and environmental degradation through improved track surfaces and drainage.
- Improve public and worker safety through upgraded track infrastructure and appropriate drainage and access.
- Improve the resilience and longevity of the track to better withstand high visitation and alpine conditions.
- Deliver track infrastructure consistent with the standard of recent upgrades to the alpine and upper sub-alpine sections.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Procurement Scope
The Contractor must have the capacity to complete the following scope in compliance with the Principal’s specifications by the end of May 2027:
- Site mobilisation and demobilisation
- Construction of approximately 350m of new rock paved track
- Construction of approximately 1,650m of new gravel walking track surface
- Construction of new stone and timber steps where required
- Reinstatement of timber platforms and edging where required
- Installation of drainage infrastructure as directed
- Logistic arrangements (coordinating aircraft operations) to deliver the materials to the site. NPWS will arrange for the aircraft
- Remediation of any damaged areas
